name: canon
_doc: Asserts the live attention-canon.md codifies every principle the cited lenses depend on, each with a real source and a testable rule. The registry_ids_present assertion pulls EVERY canon_ref from every cited lens in lens-registry.json and requires each to appear here — so a cited lens can never reference a principle the canon doesn't define.

assertions.reason: every canon_ref named by a cited lens must be defined in attention-canon.md
each principle must carry a real citation (named author/year) and an explicit testable rule
no placeholders — the canon must be complete, not stubbed
